# Bundled math renderer

MathJax 3.2.1 `es5/tex-svg.js`, distributed under Apache License 2.0 (see
MATHJAX-LICENSE.txt). Source: https://github.com/mathjax/MathJax-src/tree/3.2.1
Documentation: https://docs.mathjax.org/en/v3.2/web/hosting.html

This is the self-contained standard TeX-to-SVG component used for offline book
reading. No browser font files are distributed. A newer compatible renderer may
be chosen deliberately, but is not required merely to author course content.
Extra dynamic TeX packages are not bundled; stay with the supported core/AMS set.
